question: List Breast Chemotherapy trials where overall follow‑up exceeded 21 months.

gemini.answer: This SQL query retrieves the NCT ID, author, year, and PubMed ID for clinical trials related to breast cancer and involving chemotherapy regimens, where the overall follow-up duration exceeded 21 months.
gemini.raw:
```json
{
  "sql": "SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\" \nFROM public.\"clinical_trials\"\nWHERE \"cancer_type\" ILIKE '%Breast%'\n  AND \"treatment_regimen\" ILIKE '%Chemotherapy%'\n  AND \"follow_up_duration_overall_months\" > 21",
  "answer": "This SQL query retrieves the NCT ID, author, year, and PubMed ID for clinical trials related to breast cancer and involving chemotherapy regimens, where the overall follow-up duration exceeded 21 months.",
  "assumptions": ""
}
```
